post.title: Merge Intervals Pattern: Solve Scheduling Problems with Sort and Sweep
post.subtitle: Sort once, sweep once: three full Java solutions for the merge intervals pattern used in every scheduling system.
post.brief: Sort intervals by start time, then sweep left-to-right and merge any interval whose start ≤ the current running end. O(n log n) time, O(n) space. One pattern — three interview problems solved.
